title: 運用集計v6（時系列復元・欠落由来）事前走査の実測

entries.label: 系統別file数と行形の出現数（内容不読・件数のみ）
argv:
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/Users/keno/.reviewcompass3/projects/reviewcompass3/development/sensitive/eventual-preservation/raw')
for system_dir in sorted(p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir()):
    files = sorted(system_dir.rglob('*.jsonl'))
    print(system_dir.name, 'files:', len(files))
    if files:
        sample = files[0]
        text = sample.read_bytes()
        print(' ', 'sample_lines:', text.count(b'\n'))
        for pattern in (b'\"type\":\"tool_use\"', b'\"type\": \"tool_use\"', b'tool_use', b'\"timestamp\"', b'function_call'):
            print(' ', pattern.decode(), text.count(pattern))
